items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: when Chick's sister came up from Baltimore, we had a meeting. I had to tell her everything.

ctx.x: I say, "No, you can't do it, because it belongs to that office over there. That's where the money was made."
The whole thing was that, when Chick's sister came up from Baltimore, we had a meeting. I had to tell her everything.
I say, "Did you get the money from the Moe Gale office, because Chick had an account there."
